shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat app/page.tsx && cat app/product/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && rg --files app lib components | sort'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json && ls -d /root/.cache/ms-playwright/* /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/* 2>/dev/null | head -20'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json | head -70 && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json | head -70 && sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/@next/playwright/dist/index.js"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import { chromium } from \"@playwright/test\"; import { instant } from \"@next/playwright\"; const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true}); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto(\"http://localhost:3000/\"); await page.locator(\"a[href=\\\"/product\\\"]\").scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); await page.waitForTimeout(500); await instant(page, async () => { await page.locator(\"a[href=\\\"/product\\\"]\").click(); await page.waitForURL(\"**/product\"); console.log(JSON.stringify({title:await page.locator(\"h1\").textContent(), loading:await page.getByText(\"Loading inventory...\").isVisible(), inventory:await page.getByText(/in stock/).count()})); }); console.log(JSON.stringify({inventoryAfter:await page.getByText(/in stock/).first().textContent(), priceAfter:await page.getByText(/Price:/).first().textContent()})); await browser.close();'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import { chromium } from \"@playwright/test\"; import { instant } from \"@next/playwright\"; const browser = await chromium.launch({headless:true}); const page = await browser.newPage(); try { await page.goto(\"http://localhost:3000/\"); await page.locator(\"a[href=\\\"/product\\\"]\").scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); await page.waitForTimeout(500); await instant(page, async () => { await page.locator(\"a[href=\\\"/product\\\"]\").click(); await page.waitForURL(\"**/product\"); console.log(JSON.stringify({titleVisible:await page.getByRole(\"heading\",{name:\"Premium Widget\"}).isVisible(), loadingVisible:await page.getByText(\"Loading inventory...\").isVisible(), inventoryCount:await page.getByText(/in stock/).count()})); }); console.log(JSON.stringify({inventoryAfter:await page.getByText(/in stock/).first().textContent(), priceAfter:await page.getByText(/Price:/).first().textContent()})); } finally { await browser.close(); }'"
